text:
Rhea M.: Kicking off NimbusBank POC. Use case: streaming txn feed -> call internal FX service (function_call) -> attach structured JSON (rate, ttl, source). Env: VPC + SAML. Timeline: 3 weeks. Need: tiny Node sample, clear fallback behavior, hosted vs reserved pricing for ~1M tokens/mo and bursts up to 500 qps.

Tom B.: Confirming questions for customer: do they require HSM-backed KMS? can outbound egress to FX service be allowed (CIDR)?

Rhea M.: They asked for HSM ideally; egress allowed with IP allowlist. I'll request IDP metadata + CIDRs.

Tom B.: Engineering notes: streaming SDK emits events: delta, function_call (payload string), end. Provide function JSON schema to avoid hallucination. Tiny Node snippet below:```js
const s = client.responses.stream({model:'redwood-infer-pro-v1',stream:true,functions:[{name:'fx',parameters:{type:'object',properties:{pair:{type:'string'},rate:{type:'number'},ttl:{type:'integer'}},required:['pair','rate']}}],function_call:'auto'});
for await (const e of s) if(e.type==='function_call') handle(JSON.parse(e.payload));
```

Tom B.: For Private/Dedicated use the q4 quantized variant to save cost. If fx tool needs outbound HTTP from VPC, you need a NAT or in-VPC adaptor.

PricingBot: Hosted rough: ~$0.02 / 1k tokens => ~ $20/mo for 1M tokens. For sustained 500 qps peaks recommend Dedicated reserved pool: ballpark $8k-$10k/mo (model + SLO dependent). HSM add ~15% uplift. Expedited 2-week onboarding one-time fee possible.

Rhea M.: Fallback behavior? If reserved pool saturated, can we fallback to hosted? Customer worried about KMS differences.

Tom B.: Yes, routing policy supports prefer: dedicated and fallback to hosted-compatible model. Fallback keeps function_call plumbing, but hosted uses RW-managed keys unless BYOK configured; explain KMS tradeoffs in kickoff. Also recommend a short parity eval between the two model variants.

InfraBot: Uploaded: /secure/nimbus/secq_3123456789.pdf and SAML attr map template. IP allowlist template: /onboarding/ip-allowlist-template.md

Rhea M.: Action items: 1) I'll email NimbusBank asking for IDP metadata, HSM confirm, egress CIDRs (48h). 2) @Tom B. please prepare Node snippet + small demo harness simulating 500 qps for 60s. 3) @PricingBot post hosted vs 3mo-reserved quote and expedited onboarding line.

Tom B.: Will do. I'll also spin up a tiny canary (RW-POC-1012) and include notes about schema enforcement.

PricingBot: Quote coming in ~2h.

Rhea M.: Thanks team, emailing customer now. Will update once they reply. :thumbsup:
